flows.name: Navigate to OTP-based sign-in
flows.description: Verifies a visitor can switch from standard email/password sign-in to the OTP authentication flow, which is the primary passwordless entry path.

steps.action: Click the link labeled "Sign In with OTP"
Expect the page to display an OTP request form or phone-number input

flows.expectation: The OTP sign-in flow is accessible and presents fields for requesting a one-time password.

flows.name: Initiate forgot-password recovery
flows.description: Verifies the forgot-password recovery entry point is reachable and presents a recovery form, ensuring locked-out users are not stranded.

steps.action: Expect the page to display a password-recovery form requesting a corporation email or similar identifier

flows.expectation: The forgot-password page loads and presents a form for the user to submit their recovery request.

flows.name: Accept an invitation code to onboard
flows.description: Verifies the invitation-code onboarding path accepts input and responds, which is the only way a new user without an account can begin setup.

steps.action: Type "TESTCODE123" into the input labeled "Accept Invitation Code"
Expect the page to respond with either a validation error (invalid code) or a redirect to an onboarding/registration form

flows.expectation: The invitation code input and submit button are functional; the system validates the code and provides clear feedback.

plan.notes: This is a single-page auth surface — all three flows start from /login and diverge via distinct controls. I skipped: (1) a standard email/password sign-in flow since no credentials exist and the runner cannot execute it — this would be the only auth_required candidate but adds no value as a skipped flow; (2) cookie-consent banner interaction (minor, non-functional impact); (3) 'Request Demo' link whose destination and gating are unknown from the crawl. The invitation-code flow uses a synthetic test code; the success criterion is that the system responds to the interaction, not that the code is valid.
